Name: (AT)(CP)Song Ke' s Chinese Courtyard Wall
Author: CiChangAn
Description:
[b][size=3][color=#ff7700]* 介绍 *[/color]
*introduce *[/size][/b]
[color=#ff7700]
这是一组中式院墙mod，有AT版与CP版，AT版替换了冬日星树与陶瓷柱子。[/color]
This is a set of Chinese courtyard wall mod, there are AT versions and CP versions，AT version replaces the tree of the winter star and ceramic pillar.

[color=#ff7700]大部分的墙体都能够拼接，拼不上时可以尝试上下或左右移动一下。
[/color]Most of the walls can be joined together. If they don't fit, you can try moving them up and down or left and right.[color=#ff7700]          [/color]

————————————————————————————————————
[color=#6fa8dc]十分感谢 mushymato老师 添加的CP新增家具版本！[/color]
Thank you very much for adding the CP version，mushymato!

[color=#6fa8dc]该版本有以下修改：[/color]
This version has the following modifications:

[color=#6fa8dc]- 原本替换冬日星树的家具改为1x3碰撞[/color]
-The furniture originally intended to replace the Winter Star Tree has been changed to a 1x3 collision.
[color=#6fa8dc]- 制作了i18n中英翻译[/color]
-i18n Chinese-English translation is provided.
[color=#6fa8dc]- 部分墙做了季节性，非季节版本可以在设置里启用[/color]
-Some walls have been made seasonal. Non-seasonal versions can be enabled in the Settings
[color=#6fa8dc]- 看起来应该能通行的墙分成两半实现可通行[/color]
-The wall that seemed to be passable was divided into two halves to make it passable.

————————————————————————————————————
[color=#ff7700]注意：[/color]
PS: 

[color=#ff7700]AT版无法自动更换季节，需要手动替换。[/color]
AT version do not automatically change seasons and need to be replaced manually.
[color=#ff7700]云墙只有门可以与普通墙体衔接，其他部分会有错位！[/color]
Only the door of the cloud wall can be connected to the ordinary wall,while the other parts will be misaligned!

[color=#ff7700]大家下载前请务必阅读使用说明。[/color]
Please read the instructions before downloading.
————————————————————————————————————

[b][size=3][color=#6aa84f]* 使用方式 *[/color]
* How to use *
[/size][/b]
[size=3][b][color=#93c47d]两个文件可以二选一或全部下载（不冲突）
[/color]You can choose one of the two files or download both (without conflict)[/b][/size]

[b][size=3][color=#93c47d]AT版[/color]
AT version[/size][/b]

[color=#93c47d]确保下载了[/color] [b]SMAPI [/b][color=#93c47d]和[/color] [b]Alternative Textures[/b]。
Make sure to download[b] SMAPI[/b] and[b] Alternative Textures[/b].

[color=#93c47d]下载mod，将文件解压后放入mod文件夹里。[/color]
Download the mod, unzip the files and put them in the mod folder.
[color=#93c47d]
进入游戏后，前往木匠罗宾处购买油漆桶，左键对家具使用即可。[/color]
After entering the game, find Robin the carpenter to buy a paint bucket, left click on the furniture to use.
[size=3][b]

[/b][/size][size=3][b][color=#93c47d]CP版[/color]
CP version
[/b][/size]
[color=#93c47d]确保下载了[/color] [b]SMAPI[/b] [color=#93c47d]和 [/color][b]ContentPatcher[/b]。
Make sure to download [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]ContentPatcher[/b].

[color=#93c47d]下载mod，将文件解压后放入mod文件夹里。[/color]
Download the mod, unzip the files and put them in the mod folder.

[color=#93c47d]前往木匠罗宾处购买家具目录，在目录中获取。[/color]
Go to Carpenter Robin to purchase the furniture catalogue and obtain it in the catalogue.
